properties.displayName: UEBA - Azure VM Suspicious Command/Extension Activity
properties.description: Detects potentially suspicious Azure VM run command executions and extension installations based on anomalous behavioral indicators identified by Microsoft Sentinel UEBA
properties.query:
BehaviorAnalytics
| where ingestion_time() > ago(5m)
| extend EventMessage=ActivityInsights.EventMessage
| where EventMessage has_any ('runCommand/action', 'extensions/write')
| where ActivityInsights has 'True'
| extend SourceUser=coalesce(UserPrincipalName, tostring(UsersInsights.AccountObjectID))
| mv-apply key = bag_keys(ActivityInsights) on (where tostring(ActivityInsights[tostring(key)]) == "True"
    | project TrueKey = tostring(key))
| summarize TrueKeys = make_list(TrueKey, 8), arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SourceRecordId
| join kind=leftouter (AzureActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where OperationNameValue has_any ('runCommand/action', 'extensions/write')
    | project SourceRecordId=_ItemId, ResourceName=tostring(split(_ResourceId, '/')[-1]),_ResourceId
    | where isnotempty(ResourceName))
    on SourceRecordId
| extend Message=strcat(SourceUser, ' ', case(EventMessage endswith 'runCommand/action', strcat('executed run command on ', ResourceName, ' VM'), EventMessage endswith 'extensions/write', strcat('installed extension ', ResourceName, ' on Azure VM'), EventMessage), ' which Sentinel UEBA flagged for: ', strcat_array(TrueKeys, ', '))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    SourceIPAddress,
    SourceIPLocation,
    SourceUser,
    EventMessage,
    ResourceName,
    TrueKeys,
    ResourceId=_ResourceId,
    Message,
    SourceRecordId
